description: Create a production item in ANY area of a live event — entity is one of: milestones, timeline, schedule_items, tasks, projects, vendors, talent, roles, inventory, programming, meals, places, modes (event roster), transactions, invoices, teams, receipts. Pass name + optional status + notes + a `fields` object of entity details (e.g. milestones {target_date, category, phase}). USE THIS for milestones — a milestone is NOT a task. Requires event_id + entity + name; you must be a host.
name: create_production_item
title: Create Production Item
